doubts: This is an evaluation-methodology paper (Expected Online Performance); the 'method' is a reporting tool, so Q3/Q4 read as the search spaces of all compared algorithms (Table 5), and FQE's settings for the OPS study are not given. X3: the reported quantity is by design the expected maximum over B policies (best-of-B), coded yes on a literal reading; it is explicit, not hidden. Y1: score normalized by the best behavioral policy, mean over 100 evaluation trajectories after a fixed number of gradient steps. Y3: Walker2d, Hopper, HalfCheetah (NeoRL data), CityLearn, FinRL, Industrial Benchmark = 6, dataset levels and sizes not counted. Y4: there is no single proposed algorithm; I used BC, the paper's favoured algorithm, which loses at higher budgets. Y7: MuJoCo tasks are -v3 but CityLearn, FinRL and Industrial Benchmark have no version, so no. Q5: project page visited, it links to the GitHub code.
